registeredBy: Sam (owner); registered on his instruction to close the predictive econometrics gaps, before any run of this test
hypothesis: An ARMA(p, q) forecast of monthly y/y inflation, p and q each 0 to 2 chosen by BIC at the first origin of each year, coefficients re-estimated by exact maximum likelihood at every origin on the last 120 months, has a lower RMSE than carrying the newest figure on, 3 and 12 months ahead.
knownLimits: A different model class on the same data, window, benchmark and pass mark as cpi_forecast v2, which failed; a separate test, not a version of that one.
With p at most 2 the model cannot read the 12-month base effect the AR (lags to 13) can; the MA terms are what is being tested.
Order chosen once a year; coefficients every month.
